class: a tier run again in full at a candidate it had already passed, unchanged
caught_by: before the candidate side runs, and never under --whole, the barrier reads the record at the candidate's own key. A pass written in place, by a candidate or a whole run, that saw every input the tier copies and covers the current selection is reused: nothing runs, the tier reports reused with the key, and nothing new is recorded. A fail is never reused, and a whole run reuses only a whole record
missed_by: a candidate side that never read the cache, so a second QA pass re-ran byte-identical folders at full cost

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
